# Status meanings
{: .no_toc }

Every status badge in every Hub app shows an icon and a label, never colour alone. They mean the same thing everywhere.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| Status | Label | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `active` | Active | success |
| `deleted` | Deleted | critical |
| `disabled` | Turned off | warning |
| `expired` | Expired | neutral |
| `important` | Important | critical |
| `invited` | Invited | accent |
| `none` | No access | neutral |
| `pending` | Pending | info |
| `revoked` | Revoked | critical |
| `scheduled` | Scheduled | info |
| `suspended` | Suspended | warning |
| `unread` | Unread | accent |
